notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Devil's Sarcophagus mushroom quest
[*] Improved readability on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed issue with player clipping through sea wall
[*] Improved ocean rendering
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Press [E] on PC or [X / A] on controller to skip videos
[*] Some later-game quest related objects have been hidden until they are needed, as it was confusing.
[*] Some visual effects were being turned off during transitions to cave or underwater
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Here is what is being patched in this first post-launch patch. Due to redoing the video codecs this is a fairly hefty update, so apologies up front for that!

[list]
[*] Main quest soft locking around the cave-based quests is fixed
[*] Ultrawide monitors now supported (tested at 2560x1080)
[*] Video codecs have been changed to VP8 meaning they [i]should[/i] work without issue on Steam Deck
[*] Controls now lock when a full screen note or popup appears
[*] Fixed bug where some weather effects continued in caves and underwater
[/list]

If you run into any other bugs, please drop a quick comment in the bug megathread and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

Thanks again!

Jamie

notes.title: It Sleeps Below the Haar is Released!
notes.content:
It Sleeps Below the Haar is now available!

It has been a very long and tiring few years of development on this game. Developing a game solo is a huge undertaking and I'm really proud of the game that's come out of it!

Thank's to everyone who wishlisted the game, if you purchase it, I hope you enjoy it!

Any initial bug fixes will come soon, however I need to rest for a day or too. So I appeciate your patience with any bugs that come up. There is a pinned discussion in the Community Hub todrop any bugs you come across.

All the best, and enjoy exploring Kellas Bay!

Jamie aka Arboreta Games.
